risks.risk: Not actually food-grade (could be chemical-grade or previously used for non-food/unsafe liquids). This affects suitability and resale value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the IBC label/UN marking/food-grade stamp and any previous-contents/inspection markings on the tank and cage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-food/unknown-grade IBCs (worst-case: treated as chemical/unknown use).

risks.risk: Unknown capacity/size (liters) and whether it’s standard IBC volume; affects per-unit value.
risks.proof: A readable capacity marking (e.g., liters) or model/size label on the tank.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard IBCs only if size is assumed; otherwise price at the lowest likely size/grade based on what’s visible.

risks.risk: Potential cracks, micro-leaks, or UV brittleness not visible in the photos; could fail on delivery or after filling.
risks.proof: Video/clip showing the tank filled briefly (or a pressure/leak test) and close-ups of seams, corners, and outlet fittings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as “as-is, untested for leaks” with a discount for possible defects.

risks.risk: Outlet valve/tap/cap completeness and functionality unknown; missing parts reduce usability.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the outlet valve, tap, caps/lids, and any included hoses/adapters; show they are present and not damaged.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst-case: missing or non-functional fittings).

risks.risk: Metal cage rust level and structural integrity unknown; affects safety and handling.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the cage joints and base frame, including rust-through areas and any bends/damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as “cage condition unknown” with reduction for potential rust/weak structure.

risks.risk: Quantity/lot count uncertainty (how many usable IBCs vs. damaged/extra tanks).
risks.proof: A clear wide shot with count, plus individual photos of each IBC’s condition and fittings.
risks.if_unproven: Price per unit assuming worst-case that only the clearly shown IBCs are usable.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the IBC label/UN marking and any food-grade/previous-contents/inspection stamps (front and top).
Readable capacity/size marking (liters) on the tank.
Close-up photos of the lid/cap and outlet valve/tap area showing completeness and condition.
Video or clip of a leak/pressure test (or at minimum, a fill-and-check demonstration).
Close-up photos of the metal cage joints and base frame showing rust level and structural integrity.
A wide shot that clearly shows the total number of IBC tanks included, and individual shots for each.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item type as IBC water storage tanks, so it can be priced at worst-case for grade and condition. However, food-grade/one-time use and leak-free status are not verifiable from the photos, so the price should reflect unknown/untested risk.
